name: codex-observer
description: Read-only sidecar status observer for Codex agent sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Ask what Codex is doing without interrupting it.
interface.longDescription: Codex Observer records visible Codex hook events into a local timeline, auto-starts a localhost chat dashboard on session start, and exposes read-only status, timeline, ask, and dashboard tools for a sidecar observer agent.
